systems.name: creative-core
systems.description: The pure-Swift engines of a Mac-native creative suite: the FlareCore animation engine plus the shared CoreColor, CoreRaster, CoreAsset and CoreCatalog modules. Linux-safe, Foundation only, except CoreCatalog, which uses GRDB over the system SQLite. The Mac apps live in other repos.

containers.name: FlareCore library
containers.description: The FlareCore Swift package (Sources/FlareCore). Value types only, Codable and Sendable, and nothing crashes on untrusted input.

components.name: Document and Command Engine
components.description: The document model (Document > Scene > Layer > Shape, keyframe tracks, fills, text shapes, ruler guides, the swatch palette, metadata, frame labels) and its ModelError; LayerOwner, which addresses a scene's or a symbol's layer list; the Command protocol and CommandEngine with exact undo/redo, groups, coalescing, an undo depth limit and layer-scoped validation for single-layer commands; the CommandRegistry that decodes any command from a JSON envelope; the built-in command families (scene, layer, shape, text, keyframe, label, guide, swatch, metadata); and the .flare v1 file format with validation. Every document change goes through a Command.

components.name: Geometry
components.description: 2D affine Matrix, the Transform (position, scale, rotation) layers and instances use, axis-aligned Rect, vector Paths with line, quadratic and cubic segments, tight shape bounds, and point hit testing (even-odd and nonzero fill, strokes, through instances). Never returns non-finite values.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Frame/time conversion, keyframe interpolation with binary-search segment lookup, easing curves (linear, cubic bezier, hold), and sampling a layer's property values at a frame for rendering and export.

components.name: Export
components.description: Exporters that turn a scene into other formats: one frame as an SVG document, a scene as a Lottie JSON document with animated position and easing, and the frame plan (numbers, times, pixel sizes, file names) for a numbered PNG sequence. Output is byte-stable and throws on non-finite values.

components.name: Symbols
components.description: Reusable symbol definitions and their instances on layers: how an instance maps the host timeline onto the symbol's own timeline, the add/remove/convert-to-symbol commands, and the check that rejects symbols that contain themselves.

components.name: State Machine
components.description: Interactive state machines: states that play a frame range of a scene, transitions fired by named triggers, typed bool/number inputs with transition conditions, and the format-layer check of their invariants that FlareFormat.validate runs.

containers.name: CoreColor library
containers.description: Shared color module (Sources/CoreColor): color spaces and conversions for every app. Linux-safe, Foundation only, no dependencies.

components.name: Color Spaces
components.description: Color3 and conversions between sRGB, linear sRGB, Display P3, XYZ D65 and OKLab through one shared transfer curve; ColorError.

containers.name: CoreRaster library
containers.description: Shared raster module (Sources/CoreRaster): pixel buffers, compositing and image operations for Photo, Library and Halo. Linux-safe, Foundation only.

components.name: Pixel Buffer
components.description: PixelBuffer and RGBA: validated sizes, bounds-checked access, premultiply helpers; conversion to and from 8-bit sRGB or Display P3 display bytes; the tile grid for per-tile storage and paint, and TileDiff for tile-by-tile undo; RasterError.

components.name: Compositing
components.description: W3C blend modes and source-over compositing with opacity on premultiplied pixels.

components.name: Image Operations
components.description: Masks, resampling, crop, quarter turns and rotation by any angle with the straighten crop, blur, tone adjustments and histograms over PixelBuffer.

containers.name: CoreAsset library
containers.description: Shared asset module (Sources/CoreAsset): the Asset and AssetRef model every app imports and exports, and its manifest.json codec. Linux-safe, Foundation only, no dependencies.

components.name: Asset Model
components.description: Asset (id, kind, name, tags, version, source app, payload ref), AssetRef (id, version) and the manifest codec with size limits; AssetError.

containers.name: CoreCatalog library
containers.description: Shared catalog module (Sources/CoreCatalog): photo and metadata catalog over SQLite, used by Library and the shared asset library. Linux-safe; depends only on GRDB.

components.name: Catalog Store
components.description: The catalog schema and its migrations, record types and queries (smart collection rules compiled to SQL) over a GRDB database; CatalogError, which GRDB's errors map to.

systems.name: GRDB.swift
systems.description: External: SQLite toolkit for Swift (groue/GRDB.swift), pinned exact in Package.swift. Links the system SQLite; on Linux that needs libsqlite3-dev. Approved for CoreCatalog only.
